name: Ink Wash
tagline: A slow shan-shui landscape in graded ink on rice paper, with a rising moon, drifting mist and a vertical title with a red seal.
description: Calm, contemplative style for festivals, poetry, tea and craft brands, travel and mood pieces. Layered mountain ridges in graded ink (near peaks almost black, far ridges pale blue-grey) built from SVG paths with feTurbulence stippling and displacement for ink bleed, mist bands and clouds drifting between them, a pale moon rising behind the far range, a plum branch that inks itself in, a few birds and a small boat, and a vertical serif title with a small red seal. Captions fade in softly, with Chinese above and English below. Nothing snaps.

display.usage: Vertical title (writing-mode: vertical-rl) 104px, letter-spacing 0.22em; seal characters 25px; Chinese captions 38px, tracking 0.32em

body.usage: Italic English subtitle line 30px under each Chinese caption

transitions: layers fade up from the paper with sine.inOut, far → near, 0.3s apart
captions dissolve through blur(6px), never slide more than 10px
textAnimations: title characters resolve one by one from blur(10px), 1.3s each, 0.25s stagger
seal fades in from scale 1.12 with power2.out over 1s
Chinese line then English line fade up 10px from blur(6px), 0.35s apart

rhythm.notes: A single long take. Something new appears roughly every second (ridges, branch, title, seal, caption, birds), and the parallax drift and moonrise never stop.

guide:
- Warm rice paper (#f3eddd → #d9cfb6 radial) with a multiply fiber noise (feTurbulence baseFrequency "0.012 0.35") and a faint vignette. Ink colours only, plus one red #b23a2c for the seal and blossoms.
- Build 3 ridge layers from concave-sided peak paths filled with a vertical gradient (opaque at the tip → transparent at the base): far #8fa2aa with a heavy 3.5px blur, mid #4f5d60 and near #141614 with an feTurbulence alpha stipple plus displacement (scale ≈22) for ink bleed. Put blurred mist bands between layers.
- Parallax is linear and small: far −40px, mid −90px, near −150px over the whole piece, plus a 5% sine.inOut camera push. Moon (pale disc with a warm glow) rises ~300px behind the far range.
- Add 2–3 living details: a plum branch drawn with dashoffset strokes and red five-petal blossoms, a few V-shaped birds flapping (scaleY yoyo, finite repeat), a small boat drifting.
- Title is 3–4 characters vertical (Noto Serif SC 700, ~104px) on the right third, revealed character by character from blur, with a 64px red seal underneath. Captions: Chinese 38px tracked 0.32em, English Cormorant Garamond italic 30px below.
- Use only sine.inOut, power2.out or linear eases, with durations of 1s or more. No hard cuts, no bounce, no scale pops.
